verdict.rationale: The pack documents adjacent controls: password character requirements, refresh-token reuse detection, and TOTP/phone MFA. None of these is built-in bot protection (e.g., CAPTCHA), credential-stuffing defense (e.g., leaked-password checks), or brute-force throttling or rate limiting on auth endpoints. Adjacent controls earn no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can rely on built-in protection against bots, credential stuffing, and brute-force attacks on the auth flows
